media:group.media:title: Introducing Genie 4
media:group.media:description:
Raia Hadsell, Diego Rivas, and Hang Qi from Google DeepMind join host Logan Kilpatrick to introduce Genie 4, the latest world model from Google DeepMind.
Their conversation covers: *What world models are *The arc from Genie 1 to Genie 4 *Live demos showcasing the model’s biggest leaps forward *The role of Gemini in the loop *The path to robotics and education applications *What it means to make Genie available in the API for the first time

entry.title: Gemini 4 Argon: What’s new and what’s next

media:group.media:title: Gemini 4 Argon: What’s new and what’s next
media:group.media:description:
Josh Woodward, Melvin Johnson, Sergey Brin, and Tulsee Doshi from Google DeepMind join host Logan Kilpatrick to introduce Gemini 4 Argon. Their conversation covers what made this release possible and how 100,000 Googlers tested the model before launch. They also discuss industry-leading one million output tokens, improvements to writing quality and model behavior, and the real-world breakthroughs teams are already seeing across coding, cybersecurity, and knowledge work.

entry.title: Introducing EmbeddingGemma 2: An open model for natively multimodal embeddings

media:group.media:title: Introducing EmbeddingGemma 2: An open model for natively multimodal embeddings
media:group.media:description:
Sebastian Russo, Ivan Llanos, and Sahil Dua from Google DeepMind introduce EmbeddingGemma 2, a lightweight open model that maps text, images, video, and audio into a single unified embedding space.
At just 740 million parameters, EmbeddingGemma 2 is engineered for on-device use cases. Watch this video to discover:
*EmbeddingGemma 2’s modular architecture with optional audio and vision encoders *Instant media search and video moment retrieval running fully offline on device *Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines where sensitive data never leaves the hardware *Fine-tuning for domain-specific use cases

media:group.media:title: Introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash
media:group.media:description:
Introducing Gemini 3.7 Flash — our most intelligent workhorse model yet for coding and agents.
Follow along as we build an animated sprite-based 90s game using the model in Google Antigravity. We go from a single prompt to a plan, then to a playable game with assets generated by Nano Banana Pro and infinite remixing possibilities.
Explore agent-first workflows in Antigravity or start building in the Gemini API via Google AI Studio and Android Studio.
